Telecommunication towers in
rural areas
†*601. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are contemplating on installing
telecommunication towers in rural areas of
the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the number of villages likely to be
selected for the said purpsoe and the amount
likely to be spent on the same;
(d) whether it is also a fact that said
towers installed at present in rural areas
generally remain out of order; and
(e) if not, the details of said towers
installed during the last two years, State-
wise?
Mass Transit Systems
*602. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of URBAN DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of steps taken or proposed
to be taken for the successful
implementation of Mass Transit Systems
(rapid bus and rail based) in various parts of
the country while seeking rapid growth of
urban population and its deterioration impact
on urban transports;
(b) whether Government have received
any proposal from various parts of the
country;
(c) if so, the details thereof and
Government's response thereto;
(d) whether Government have made any
comprehensive project with regard to Mass
Transit Systems; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

MoU with States for capacity building
programme for PRIs
*603. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of
PANCHAYATI RAJ be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Government has
signed an MoU with the States to launch an
effective capacity building programme for
Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs) which in
turn would promote and implement the
drinking water schemes;
(b) if so, the schemes that are to be
implemented by PRIs and how much
financial outlay is earmarked for the same
in the year 2007-08;
(c) whether the PRIs would be entrusted
with the task of subsequent operation and
maintenance of the scheme;
(d) if so, how much additional work force
would be roped in; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Providing low cost housing
finance
*604. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA: Will
the Minister of HOUSING AND URBAN
POVERTY ALLEVIATION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have any policy
for providing low cost housing finance to
people from economically weaker sections;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Rural business hubs
*605. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of PANCHAYATI RAJ
be pleased to state:
(a) the action plan of Government to set
up rural business hubs to improve the
economy of the rural India;
(b) the status of Orissa State in
development of such hubs in the backward
region; and
(c) to what extent this initiative would
control rural influx to urban sector?
FDI in cruise shipping space
*606. SHRIMATI SUPRIYA SULE:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the draft policy, prepared by
a steering group headed by the Shipping and
Tourism Ministers has been considered by
the Committee of Secretaries for approval
of the Central Government;
(b) if so, whether the policy seeks to
encourage foreign direct investment in cruise
shipping space;
(c) if so, the other main aims of the policy;
(d) whether Government have approved
the same; and
(e) by what time it is likely to be
announced?
Correct estimate of poverty
*607. SHRI RAHUL BAJAJ:
SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) the technically correct estimate of
poverty in country during 2004-05 as there
are two estimates floating around, one of
22 per cent, which is being used generally

192
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
by the media and Government and another
of 27.5 per cent which the Economic Survey
states is the one that is comparable to the
figure of 36 per cent of 1993-94;
(b) if the latter is correct, whether it is a
fact that poverty in the last ten years has
reduced more slowly than in the 1980s; and
(c) if so, the reasons for which the figure
of 22 per cent is being used by Government?
Women deserted by NRI husbands
*608. SHRIMATI BRINDA KARAT:
Will the Minister of OVERSEAS INDIAN
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether any action has been taken
by Government to redress the plight of Indian
women deserted by their NRI husbands;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Difference between tariff rates of
courier services
†*609. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
huge difference between the tariff rates of
courier services of the private sector and
public sector;
(b) if so, the facts in this regard;
(c) whether Government have
formulated any plan to bring down this
difference to a competitive level; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Gap between demand and supply of
coal
*610. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the total production of coal in different
parts of the country by all coal companies
as on date;
(b) the present demand of coal in the
country, State-wise, particularly in the State
of Andhra Pradesh; and
(c) the details of the steps taken or
proposed to be taken by Government to fill
up the gap between demand and supply of
coal products in the country particularly in
the State of Andhra Pradesh?
Backward Regions Grant Fund
*611. SHRI PRAVEEN RASHTRA-
PAL: Will the Minister of PANCHAYATI
RAJ be pleased to state:
(a) the districts so far that are declared
for the benefits under ‘‘Backward Regions
Grants Fund’’, state-wise;
(b) what is the criterion for such selection;
(c) whether he would agree that giving
funds directly to State administration is not
serving required purpose as envisaged by
the Central Government; and
(d) if so, the remedial steps proposed?
Maintenance of roads under NHDP
*612. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government

193
of India is not sanctioning the strengthening
works under plan on the stretches which
have been identified under NHDP during the
period of sanctioning the works by NHAI;
and
(b) if so, who will be responsible for poor
maintenance of roads during this period?
Watch on grievance cells of
Ministries, etc.
*613. SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRA-
SEKHAR: Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Department of Public
Grievances keeps a watch on the grievance
cells of various Ministries, Departments and
Organizations of the Central Government to
ensure that the complaints received by them
are promptly and correctly disposed of;
(b) if so, the procedure adopted for the
purpose;
(c) whether any surprise checks have
been conducted by the Department;
(d) if so, the cases of violations detected
during the last three years ending 31st
December, 2006, Ministry-wise and
Department-wise; and
(e) the action taken against those
responsible for violating orders on the
subject?
World class infrastructure facilities for
cricket
*614. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS
AND SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have taken a
serious note of the dismal performance of
the Indian cricket team in the Cricket World
Cup and controversies over foreign coach;
(b) if so, Government's assessment on
the causes for the same; and
(c) whether Government would ensure
that a fair amount of earning of BCCI is
spent on world class infrastructure facilities
for the game of cricket and on grooming of
players with highest-level of fitness?
Special package for Orissa
†*615. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY: Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether maximum number of people
living below poverty line live in Orissa and
whether Orissa would be called the poorest
State from this point of view;
(b) if so, whether his Ministry has any
specific scheme for improvement of the
economic condition of the poor people of
the said State; and
(c) whether the State Government has
asked for any special economic package
from the Centre?
Threat of terrorists
†*616. SHRI SATYAVRAT
CHATURVEDI:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that threat of
terrorists attacks on ports, ship building
factories and related institutions in the
country has been received;
(b) whether Government have
constituted a high level Committee to inspect
security preparations;
(c) if so, by when the report of the
Committee would be received; and
(d) by when the steps regarding the
security would be taken?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Software Technology Parks
*617. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the export growth of
Software Technology Parks of India units
has been decreasing during the last three
years;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the action taken to rectify the
situation?
Improving ties with major
powers
*618. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether after the India-China-Russia
trilateral framework, India has started
discussion on a four-cornered dialogue
between India, Japan the United States and
Australia on upward spiral of improving ties
with all major powers of the world;
(b) if so, whether India has decided to
improve its ties with all its major partners to
promote India's economic and commercial
interest abroad;
(c) if so, to what extent these talks have
been helpful and would help India among
global powers; and
(d) whether India has sought the support
of Japan for gaining access to high-tech
know-how and equipment for peaceful use
of atomic energy?
Implementation of Bharat Nirman
*619. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Prime Minister has decided
to take steps to remove the bottlenecks that
come in the way of timely implementation
of Government's flagship programme i.e.
Bharat Nirman and also to push for speedy
environment clearance for rural road
projects and also changing the current fund
flow arrangements of the irrigation
programme; and
(b) if so, what are the concrete steps
Prime Minister has taken particularly with
six major components, i.e. irrigation, roads,
houses, drinking water, electricity and
telephone connectivity?
De-congestion of urban population
*620. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: W ill the Minister of
URBAN DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 285 million
urban people in the country account for
28 per cent of the country's total population
which is estimated to double by 2025;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reaction of Government in this regard; and
(c) what steps Government would take
to de-congest the urban population by that
time?

 Will the  PRIME MINISTER be

private mobile companies
